errors.invalid_client: This app is not registered with Campbooks.
errors.invalid_redirect_uri: This app asked to return to an address it did not register.
errors.csrf_check_failed: This request did not come from Campbooks itself.
errors.way_in_belongs_to_another_account: This account is already a way into another Campbooks account. Sign in with it to use that account.
errors.sign_up_expired: This sign-up took too long. Sign in again to start over.
errors.invalid_return_to: After signing in, Campbooks can only return to one of its own pages.
errors.held_grant_not_found: There is no mailbox waiting to be connected.
errors.invalid_id_token_hint: This sign-out request is not signed by Campbooks for this app; nothing was ended.
errors.signup_invite_only: This Campbooks takes invited people only. Ask someone to invite this address, then sign in again.
errors.step_up_required: Sign in again first: changing how you sign in needs a sign-in from the last ten minutes.
errors.last_way_in: This is the only way you can sign in, so it can't be removed. Add another way first.
errors.link_incomplete: Say which provider, workspace or mailbox this is for.
errors.mailbox_unsupported: Campbooks can't connect this provider's mailbox on this instance yet.
errors.passkey_not_accepted: This passkey wasn't accepted. Try again, or sign in another way.
errors.passkey_expired: This passkey request took too long or was already used. Try again.
errors.passkey_already_registered: This passkey is already a way into Campbooks.
errors.display_name_required: Say what we should call you.
errors.passkey_name_required: Give the passkey a name of 1 to 64 characters.
errors.invalid_target: This app asked for access to something Campbooks does not serve.
errors.consent_request_not_found: This request to allow an app expired or was already answered. Start again from the app.
errors.consent_needs_workspace: Choose the workspace this app may use.
errors.consent_wrong_workspace: This app belongs to another workspace and can only be allowed there.
errors.not_workspace_admin: Only the workspace's owners and admins can manage its apps.
errors.client_not_found: There is no such app in this workspace.
errors.invalid_client_metadata: The app's details are not acceptable: {{reason}}
errors.client_needs_redirect: A sign-in app needs at least one https or loopback return address.
errors.client_scope_not_allowed: Apps can't be given the {{scope}} permission.
errors.client_is_public: This app signs people in and has no secret to rotate.
errors.client_name_reserved: Only Campbooks’ own apps may be called Campbooks or Not A Camp. Choose another name.
errors.fresh_sign_in_required: Sign in again first: adding a passkey needs a sign-in from the last five minutes.

way_in_added.subject: A new way to sign in to your Campbooks account
way_in_added.added: {{what}} was added as a way to sign in to your Campbooks account on {{when}}.
way_in_added.if_you: If this was you, there is nothing to do.
way_in_added.if_not: If it wasn’t you, open Campbooks, go to Settings → Ways to sign in, remove it, and choose Sign out everywhere.
way_in_added.why: Campbooks sends this to your account’s addresses whenever a way to sign in is added. It contains no tracking.
